title: Amazon winds down most flagship AI models in strategy overhaul, Business Insider reports

title: Meta, BlackRock partner on $14 billion El Paso data center
title_zh: Meta 与贝莱德合作斥资 140 亿美元建设埃尔帕索数据中心
summary: Meta Platforms and the world's largest asset manager BlackRock on Tuesday announced a venture to develop and operate a data center campus ‌in El Paso, Texas, a project that would cost about $14 billion in ‌development.
summary_zh: Meta Platforms 和全球最大的资产管理公司贝莱德周二宣布成立合资公司，在德克萨斯州埃尔帕索开发和运营一个数据中心园区，该项目的开发成本约为 140 亿美元。
